# netbox_config_template (Resource)

Manages a NetBox config template (`/api/extras/config-templates/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_tag" "example" {
  name = "example-tag"
  slug = "example-tag"
}

resource "netbox_config_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
  template_code = "example"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  tags = [netbox_tag.example.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `template_code` (String) Jinja template code.

### Optional

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Download file as attachment. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `auto_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic synchronization of data when the data file is updated. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `data_source_id` (Number) ID of the Data Source (`netbox_data_source`).
- `debug` (Boolean) Enable verbose error output when rendering this template. Not recommended for production use. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `environment_params` (String) Any <a href="https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/api/#jinja2.Environment">additional parameters</a> to pass when constructing the Jinja environment.
- `file_extension` (String) Extension to append to the rendered filename. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `file_name` (String) Filename to give to the rendered export file. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `mime_type` (String) Defaults to <code>text/plain; charset=utf-8</code>. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_config_template can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_config_template.example 123
```
